description: A twenty-four stage analogue sequencer, running as one row of twenty-four or three rows of eight, with its own clock and a glide on the master output

params.text: Sets the voltage that stage puts out, marked -5 to +5
Sets the rate of the internal clock
Sets how long the master output takes to slide from one stage's voltage to the next
Sets how much of the add input is mixed into the master output, marked -5 to +5
Sets how long the gate outputs stay high within each step
Advances the sequence by one stage each time it is pressed
Starts the sequence running from where it stopped
Sends the sequence back to its first stage and starts it
Halts the sequence where it is
Sets the last stage of the sequence to the stage playing now
Picks whether the sequencer runs as one row of twenty-four stages or three rows of eight
Picks whether the stage outputs swing either side of zero or stay above it
Picks whether the sequence stops at the end or runs round again
Picks whether the sequence counts upwards only or turns round at the end
Picks the band the rate knob works in
Picks whether the sequencer is clocked by its own oscillator or by the source jack

inputs.text: Clocks the sequence when the source switch is set to external
A gate here starts the sequence running
A gate here sends the sequence back to its first stage and starts it
A gate here halts the sequence
Mixed into the master output through the add knob

outputs.text: The voltage of the stage playing in that row
A gate while that row's stage is playing
The stage voltage after the glide and the add mix
A pulse when the sequence reaches its last stage
A gate at each step, at the width set by the gate width knob
